contract.review_scope: Full retained body read, authored input/output/effect/branch/configuration/error/transaction/concurrency explanations; source current per owner.
contract.purpose: Drill inventory location charts from a locating zone to location type.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration; placeholders are not executable argument values: CREATE Procedure INV_MonitorLocationTypeChartData @filterCriteria nVarchar(MAX), @culture nvarchar(10) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: NULL zone means only NULL LOCATING_ZONE, not all zones. Empty SUM totals can be NULL. NOT IN can be affected by NULL inventory locations.
output_shape: Five result sets with chart category/data/description/axis/title metadata and four scalar summary tiles; NextDrillDownLevel=2.

ordered_branches.explanation: Parse warehouse and locating zone; translate one coded zone sentinel to NULL. Filter chart and total/empty counts to exact zone or NULL-to-NULL, then group chart by LOCATION_TYPE and order DATA descending.
Calculate percentage from summed location/status groups. Frozen-empty tile omits the selected zone and excludes location names found anywhere in LOCATION_INVENTORY. Return chart plus four tiles.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: Read-only drilldown; tile and chart scopes differ.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: Outer warehouse restriction applies; selected zone is not applied to the frozen-empty tile. culture localizes the NULL type label.
error_and_return_handling: Only final @@ERROR/GOTO handling; normal return 0 and NOCOUNT OFF.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoint or SET XACT_ABORT in this body. Caller/session transaction behavior governs partial completion; this contract does not assume atomic child calls.
concurrency: Five result sets come from separate statements without a common snapshot.
contract.trigger_behavior: No direct persistent DML; called routines retain their own trigger and effect contracts.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Application callers, current record state and active permissions were not observed. No extension, assembly or Azure-function changes are required by this documentation task.
Explicit child/function calls are listed; their exact source contracts bound transitive effects. Opaque selectors are retained as technical evidence, without fabricated labels.
